# webtables/as

> Conversion: `x as T`. To `u8` keeps the low byte, to `bool` tests for non-zero.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/as.pkg) · translates [std/as](../std/as.md)

Other conversions keep the word.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when t u8`

```nasm
(i64.and
{v}
(i64.const 255))
```

### `emit when t bool`

```nasm
(i64.extend_i32_u (i64.ne
{v}
(i64.const 0)))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{v}
```
